_comment: Environment config for the video pipeline. make-video.ps1 and record.mjs both read this. Environment variables override anything here.
_logins: The landlord app is the AGENCY app (rent roll, arrears, applications, work orders), so it signs in as the agency owner. sipho@owner.demo.test is the property owner and belongs to the web /portal, not here.
_otpLog: The API's stdout is tee'd here by make-video.ps1 so the recorder can read the [OTP] line instead of asking you for it. This is the whole trick to unattended runs.
_services: Set any of these false if you'd rather start that piece yourself.
_reseed: Reseed the Demo Agency before recording so every run films identical data.
_timeouts: Seconds to wait for each service to answer before giving up.
_stopWhenDone: Kill the API/web/Expo processes this script started once recording finishes. Docker containers are left running.
